headline: The Seedance AI video generator has launched version 3.0, which can make 30-second clips in 4K from up to 50 reference images, videos and audio files.
score_reason: Kept at pool score 5: a notable product upgrade, but the specifications are the maker's claims and nothing was tested.
importance_line: Creators and marketers who make social and product videos get longer single clips and more control over consistency, but the claims are untested and the article does not say who makes Seedance or when it went on sale.
summary: Startup Fortune reports that Seedance 3.0, the latest version of an AI video generator, can make single clips of up to 30 seconds (up from 15) and accept up to 50 reference files, against 15 in version 2.0. It also defaults to native 4K output and adds 3D planning tools for camera positions; these are the product's own claims and the article does not name the developer.
notes: Release date and developer not stated in the article, so freshness is marked NEW on the strength of the 14 Oct 2026 publication.
